Class WidgetTree.Widget

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.widgets.WidgetTree.Widget
Enclosing class:
WidgetTree
public final class WidgetTree.Widget extends Object
One screen's live control. Holding this object after screen disposal is an error.
